record.question: Which of the following is TRUE regarding the certificate of fitness for transport vehicles under Section 56 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988?
options: A transport vehicle does not require a certificate of fitness to be validly registered.
The certificate of fitness can only be issued by the Central Government.
If a certificate of fitness is cancelled, the vehicle's registration and permit are suspended until a new certificate is obtained.
The certificate of fitness is valid only in the state where it was issued.
